134	export async function streamAiChat(
135	  messages: AiMessage[],
136	  system: string | undefined,
137	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
138	  signal?: AbortSignal,
139	): Promise<string> {
140	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
141	    method: 'POST',
142	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
143	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
144	    signal,
145	  })
146	  if (!res.ok) {
147	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
148	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
149	  }
150	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
151	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
152	  let buffer = ''
153	  let fullContent = ''
154	
155	  while (true) {
156	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
157	    if (done) break
158	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
159	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
160	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
161	    for (const line of parts) {
162	      const trimmed = line.trim()
163	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
164	      try {
165	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
166	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
167	          fullContent += event.content
168	          onChunk(event.content)
169	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
170	          fullContent = event.content
171	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
172	          throw new Error(event.error)
173	        }
174	      } catch (e) {
175	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
176	        throw e
177	      }
178	    }
179	  }
180	  return fullContent
181	}
